# thalassa_containerregistry_namespace (Resource)

Create and manage a container registry namespace in Thalassa Cloud

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thalassa_containerregistry_namespace" "example" {
  region      = "nl-01"
  namespace   = "example"
  description = "Example container registry namespace"
}

output "namespace_id" {
  value = thalassa_containerregistry_namespace.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Name of the container registry namespace
- `region` (String) Region slug where the namespace is created (e.g. nl-01). Import as region/identity.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the namespace
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the namespace. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `id` (String) Identity of the container registry namespace
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the namespace
- `total_size_bytes` (Number) Total size of images in the namespace in bytes
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
